reason: Real: every getX in both stores returns the cached payload unconditionally, with no timestamp and no eviction. The Load button sets the same symbol string and retryTab calls the same short-circuiting accessor, so nothing in the panel can refetch, and no as-of is shown. The headline mechanism is overstated, though: the sidecar route caches the same data for 6 h (ratings) or 24 h (earnings history), so a frontend refresh would not reveal an 11:00 downgrade after a 09:00 load anyway. The frontend's permanence only adds staleness beyond the sidecar TTL in long desktop sessions. The durable defect is the missing as-of and the missing refresh on a data-trust surface: medium, not high.

reason: The headline repro is disproven. /news never returns 4xx for a bad NewsAPI key: _fetch_newsapi_resilient swallows the failure and returns [], and RSS still answers. The only error is ProviderError when all sources fail, which is a 502 and legitimately retriable. Live: an invalid key header gives 200 in 2.4 s. The retry-hook consumers (macro/earnings/SEC) likewise map provider failures to 502, so the proposed 4xx gate would never fire. What survives is narrower: a permanent upstream failure disguised as 502 still waits about 50 s through 12 retries, and store/sec.ts:241-243 discards the error message. That second point is in searchCompanies, which has no UI (see -7).
